normalization_policy: Raw values and all repeated CTS rows are retained. Signed ISO-style fields use astronomical years, where year zero is 1 BCE. GLAUx's unspecified signed-year convention retains both astronomical and historical interpretations; none is selected. Multiple or ambiguous intervals are never collapsed to a midpoint. Exact CTS work suffixes remain distinct. No dates, century tags, identities, or text are overwritten.

provenance.citation: Bilby, Mark G. (2024). OGA v0.2.0 (2024-11-24) and GLAUx v1.0 (2024-04-09) Compared (0.1). Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14254073
provenance.creator: Mark G. Bilby
provenance.derivation: The three CSVs derive from OGA and GLAUx metadata. They are a finding aid and normalized comparison, not an independent third dating source. Matched rows contain one date field, not separate OGA and GLAUx dates.
provenance.title: OGA v0.2.0 (2024-11-24) and GLAUx v1.0 (2024-04-09) Compared
